purpose: Requirements separating SKILL.md (orchestration, judgment, user dialogue) from scripts (deterministic processing), defining clean-state rules, input responsibility, and SKILL-local wrapper boundaries.
summary: Background: SKILL.md as resident context; cognitive load from script-specific details
Goal: SKILL.md keeps interpretation, progress, branching; scripts handle fixed values and deterministic work
FNC-001: what SKILL.md may and may not contain
FNC-002: classification of script inputs by value origin
FNC-003: one scene, one fixed invocation contract
FNC-004: placement order for misuse prevention, no prohibition warnings in SKILL.md
FNC-005: measurement-based refactoring judged by review and grep
FNC-006: SKILL-local wrapper boundaries over shared low-level scripts
Scope covers all forge SKILL.md files and scripts
Non-goals: minimizing wrappers, unified entry point, quantitative targets
tasks: Designing a script or wrapper for a SKILL
Reviewing SKILL.md and script responsibility split
Invoking inherited skills via the Skill tool
title: REQ-003 SKILL.md と script の責務分離要件
